reply.text:
I'm glad you told me, and I don't want to build a plan around that fear. Being scared of a whole food group and cutting it out completely is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help you work out what's right for you. I'm not going to set up workouts around eating no carbs, because training hard on very little fuel isn't something I'll build for you.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to build you a program or a session that fits where you are. Until then, I'm here for any training questions.
